question: Talk shows have been held recently. Will there be an autograph session sometime soon? We're looking forward to one!
answer:
I'd love to hold an autograph session, but talk shows are more fun! (laughs)

With autograph sessions, you're usually limited to about one minute per person...

With a talk show like this, on the other hand, I can spend one or two hours talking with everyone, which makes it much better in terms of interaction.

That said, autograph sessions have their own unique appeal, and there's something important about signing a book and handing it directly to someone. So if I could do both—say, a talk show once a year and an autograph session once a year—I'd definitely like to.
